_comment: ENTERPRISE MANAGED SETTINGS — install to the SYSTEM managed dir (root-owned) per INSTALL.md. Managed settings sit ABOVE local .claude/settings.json in precedence ('Managed (highest) - can't be overridden by anything', code.claude.com/docs/en/settings) so the worker cannot disable or re-point this Stop hook without admin. This macOS variant points at the wrapper installed in /Library/Application Support/ClaudeCode/. For Linux use /etc/claude-code/, for Windows C:\Program Files\ClaudeCode\ (NOT the deprecated C:\ProgramData\) — see INSTALL.md. Optional stronger lockdown: add "allowManagedHooksOnly": true (also move the SessionStart boot hook into this file, since it blocks all non-managed hooks).
